# #2269: Patch: a Tradable hand hint, dimmed once the turn's Trade is spent
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

## What it does

On the viewer's own hand cards with the Tradable keyword (SPEC §6.1, R1838000), show a small Tradable pip using the hand hint system from #2267. It is a single entry in the hint list plus its icon (a small two-way arrows / swap mark in `cards/icons.tsx`'s style): tiny, in the corner, no number, no motion.

**Dimmed once the Trade is spent:** when the viewer has no Trades left this turn, the pip is drawn dimmed (the hint system's `dimmed` state) on every Tradable card in the hand, and its label says no Trades are left this turn.

Where the data comes from (only the view, CLAUDE.md rule 7):

- **Is it Tradable:** the keywords the hand card shows: its `CardView.keywords` where the view gives them (they are set only where they differ from the face, B5 E38, R243), otherwise its face's printed keywords, read the way the card face already reads them (`cards/model.ts`). The pip is shown on both players' turns, not only when the Trade bar can be used.
- **Used this turn:** `PlayerView.trades.left === 0` (`TradesView`, set while the hand holds a Tradable card; `trades::trades_left`). Do not count trades yourself and do not read `TRADE_COST` or any rule.

This does not replace or change the Trade control (`game/TradeControl.tsx`, `trade.css`): the bar above a pointed-at card stays the way to Trade, with its price and the engine's refusal reason. The pip is only a passive mark so a player can see which cards in a big hand are Tradable without pointing at each one.

## Acceptance

- A vitest test for the hint: a hand card whose keywords include `Tradable` gets the pip; one without does not; with `trades.left > 0` it is not dimmed, with `trades.left === 0` it is dimmed and its label says so.
- A vitest test that the Trade control still appears and works as before over a Tradable card that has the pip (an existing TradeControl/Game test still passing is enough if it covers that).
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test` and `pnpm exec eslint apps/web e2e` pass.

Blocked by #2267

   /** #2269: the Tradable pip (R1838000) … */
   const TRADABLE: HandHint = {
     id: "tradable",
     icon: "trade",

       if (!hasKeyword(face.keywords, "Tradable")) return null;

Add:

   - `it("#2269 a Tradable card by its printed keywords gets the pip, dimmed once the turn's Trade is spent", …)`: render with the shared `withCatalog` helper from `../test/board.tsx` (do not define a local one — `helpers.test.ts` forbids it; import `CATALOG`-backed default), card `card({ defId: "meditative-053", cost: 1 })` with no `keywords` field, view `baseView({ trades: { cost: 0, left: 1 } })` → pip present, not dimmed; rerender with `trades: { cost: 0, left: 0 }` → `data-dimmed="true"` and `aria-label "No Trades left this turn"`. Then `cleanup()`, `await setLocale("zh-CN")`, rerender the spent case and expect `aria-label "本回合没有剩余交易次数"`.
7. **`apps/web/src/game/TradeControl.test.tsx`**: add `it("R1838000 #2269 the Trade control still appears over a Tradable card wearing the hint pip", …)`: import `withCatalog` from `../test/board.tsx` and `handHintsTestid` from `./HandHints.tsx`; render `<Game>` exactly as `renderGame` does but wrapped in `withCatalog`, with `holding()` (h1 is `meditative-053`, Tradable on its printed faces, no `keywords` field) and `[TRADE_H1, END_TURN]`; `pointAt("h1")`; expect `within(screen.getByTestId(handHintsTestid("h1"))).getByRole("img", { name: "Tradable" })` present and not dimmed, the trade bar present with a live control, and `fireEvent.click(control)` sends `TRADE_H1`. - New/updated hint tests: `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/HandHints.test.tsx`
- Control coexistence plus existing control tests: `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/TradeControl.test.tsx`
- Full web unit suite (acceptance requires it): `pnpm --dir apps/web test`
- Types and lint (acceptance requires them): `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` and `pnpm exec eslint apps/web e2e`

## Done when

- [ ] A Tradable hand card shows the pip (`data-hint="tradable"`, no number, no motion) and a non-Tradable one shows no row; both players' turns included.
- [ ] With `trades.left === 0` the pip is dimmed with the no-Trades-left label; with `left > 0` (or no `trades`) it is not dimmed with the `Tradable` label, in English and Chinese.
